text:
REASON: The reviewer correctly identifies the fatal flaw of regression to the mean (comparing extreme bottom-decile stores against themselves with no control group amidst high natural volatility) and demands a control group before proceeding. The recommendation is to revise and resubmit, not to abandon the idea entirely, so it is blocked but not killed.
FLAW_CAUGHT: 1
KILLED: 0
BLOCKED: 1
